parameters.name: HostAccountName
parameters.description: The name of the host account. The name can be up to 128 characters in length.

parameters.name: HostId
parameters.description:
The ID of the host to which you want to add a host account.

>  You can call the [ListHosts](~~200665~~) operation to query the ID of the host.

parameters.name: HostShareKeyId
parameters.description: The ID of the shared key.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
The ID of the bastion host in which you want to add a host account to the host.

>  You can call the [DescribeInstances](~~153281~~) operation to query the ID of the bastion host.

parameters.name: PassPhrase
parameters.description:
The passphrase for the private key of the host account.

> You can configure this parameter only if ProtocolName is set to SSH. You do not need to configure this parameter if ProtocolName is set to RDP.

parameters.name: Password
parameters.description: The password of the host account.

parameters.name: PrivateKey
parameters.description:
The private key of the host account. Specify a Base64-encoded string.

> This parameter is valid only if ProtocolName is set to SSH. You do not need to configure this parameter if ProtocolName is set to RDP. You can configure a password and a private key for the host account at the same time. If both a password and a private key are configured for the host account, Bastionhost preferentially uses the private key for logon.

parameters.name: ProtocolName
parameters.description:
The protocol of the host to which you want to add a host account.

Valid values:

*   SSH
*   RDP

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region ID of the bastion host in which you want to add a host account to the host.

>  For more information about the mapping between region IDs and region names, see [Regions and zones](~~40654~~).

example.unifiedCli: aliyun yundun-bastionhost create-host-account --instance-id bastionhost-cn-st220aw0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --host-id 1 --protocol-name SSH --host-account-name accountname --password 123456 --biz-private-key LS0tLS1000000RCBSU0tLQ== --pass-phrase 123456 --host-share-key-id 1 --privilege-type Normal --rotation-mode Self --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun yundun-bastionhost CreateHostAccount --region cn-hangzhou --ProtocolName SSH --HostAccountName accountname --PrivateKey 'LS0tLS1000000RCBSU0tLQ==' --InstanceId 'bastionhost-cn-st220aw0000' --RotationMode Self --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --HostId 1 --PassPhrase 123456 --HostShareKeyId 1 --PrivilegeType Normal --Password 123456
